name: inblog
description:
inblog is a blogging platform for companies that want their blog to bring in search traffic and leads. This connector puts the same workspace inside Claude.

What you can do:
- Draft a post and get a private preview link before anything goes live, then publish, schedule, or unpublish it.
- Organise the blog: tags, authors, redirects, and uploaded images.
- Read performance: traffic over time, referring sources, per-post results, and Google Search Console keywords and pages.
- Review leads captured by the blog forms.
- Update blog settings, banner and navigation, and the custom Handlebars design code, with a validation tool to check code before it goes live.

Every action runs as the signed-in user and respects the permission that user already holds on the blog, so an author cannot do what only an owner may do. Write actions return the URL of what changed so you can verify it. Requires an inblog account on the Team plan or higher.

_published_faq.name: How do I add inblog to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add inblog to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://inblog.ai/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the inblog MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: inblog lists 38 MCP tools, including create_post, create_redirect, create_tag, delete_post, delete_redirect, delete_tag, get_blog, get_design_code, get_design_guide, get_domain_status, get_form_response, and get_post.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to inblog?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to inblog in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
inblog requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
inblog is developed by inblog. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
